game_title: Digit Mill – Moss Door Chamber Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the digits value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
